items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Professor Milton. Well, he started me, he started me to, to, to learn how to read.

ctx.x: And, uh, then when I did decide, matter of fact, I even forgot where I put the trumpet at. But we had one of those old time armors with them big high armors. Yeah. And the trumpet was on top of the arm. See? And the armors was almost hitting the ceiling, so quite natural, I couldn't see. You know what I'm saying? And, uh, and I don't know, fumbling around there, and I happened to run, I said, oh, look at my trumpet up here. Then I got the thing down. I mean, boy, they had dust about an inch thick on it, you know?…
Do you remember your very first job?
